# Lingchu Bot 0.5.1.dev3

Platform permission modules are now loaded only for the adapters selected by
`LINGCHUAdapter`. You no longer need to install an adapter for a platform you
do not use.

## Highlights

### Adapter-Gated Permission Loading

`permissions/platforms.py::_iter_permission_modules()` now walks only the
platform profiles whose adapter is enabled (via the new `iter_enabled_profiles()`
/ `is_profile_enabled()` registry helpers) instead of importing every platform
permission module. Two surfaces benefit:

- **Startup seed enumeration**: unused platforms' permission modules are never
  imported and their identity-group seeds are not created, so a Telegram-only
  deployment no longer requires `nonebot-adapter-onebot` (and vice versa).
- **Runtime resolution**: `resolve_runtime_identity_groups()` only ever imports
  the permission module of the platform an event originates from, and only when
  that adapter is enabled.

Enabling a platform later re-seeds its identity groups on the next startup.

## Installation

```bash
pip install nonebot-plugin-lingchu-bot==0.5.1.dev3
```

Docker:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot:0.5.1.dev3
```

## Verify Build Provenance

```bash
gh attestation verify nonebot_plugin_lingchu_bot-0.5.1.dev3-py3-none-any.whl \
  --repository xinvxueyuan/lingchu-bot
```
